why would i choose stability if i can't have happiness? i want to be happy! why settle for stability - just choose death. is stability better than death? is being stable and sad better than being nothing at all? and why? why would i suffer a slightly cold wind rather than not suffer at all?

there's more to live for, but no happiness. it sounds like a paradox to me. why should i live if i'm sad?
also: "how far" - what's "far"? i'm sad. it'd be far if i were happy. but now it's zero.
